response.overview: In this darkly comedic psychological thriller, Ricky—a charming but reckless man—returns to his estranged lover Paul with a shocking confession: he’s dying and wants to stage his own accidental death to secure a $500,000 insurance payout for Paul. With the help of his volatile accomplice Kitto, Ricky concocts a plan involving whisky, sleeping pills, and a cliffside plunge. But Paul, already on the brink of suicide himself, has his own secrets and emotional wounds.  As Ricky’s manipulative charm collides with Paul’s despair, the line between love and exploitation blurs. A rooftop proposal turns into a twisted suicide pact, and Kitto’s growing impatience erupts into violence. response.title: Killers_Paul
